body.zh-Hant: 薩拉查出身葡萄牙中部村莊維米耶羅一個家境普通的鄉村家庭，念過神學院後放棄教士之路，改讀科英布拉大學法律，並領導當地最知名的天主教學生組織。他之後走學術路線，成為經濟法教授；1921年以天主教中央黨身分當選議員，同年7月議會提前解散後離開議席，回到學界。
body.en: Salazar came from a modest rural family in Vimieiro, a village in central Portugal. He attended a seminary but left it to study law at Coimbra, where he led the best-known Catholic student organization, and then pursued an academic career as a professor of economic law. Elected a deputy for the Catholic Center Party in 1921, he left the seat when parliament was dissolved early in July 1921 and returned to academic life.

heading.en: Entering the cabinet and becoming prime minister

body.zh-Hant: 1926年軍事政變後的第一屆內閣曾邀他加入，他見局勢仍不穩而婉拒；兩年後再度受邀，他附帶條件接受：須對其他部會握有重權，以解決軍事獨裁政權的預算危機。1932年他出任總理。1933年憲法經公民投票通過，他由上而下建立了一個單一政黨。
body.en: After the 1926 military coup Salazar was invited to join the first cabinet but declined. Asked again two years later, he accepted on condition of important powers over the other ministries, to resolve the dictatorship's budgetary crisis. He became prime minister in 1932. A new constitution approved in a popular plebiscite in 1933 followed, and he created a single party from above.

heading.en: The New State and the Second World War

body.zh-Hant: 由於政權的軍事出身，薩拉查的地位與總統卡爾莫納綁在一起，總統保有罷免其任命官員（包括薩拉查）的權力。1936年鄰國西班牙內戰爆發後，新國家趨於激進化。1939年宣布中立後，這個獨裁政權主要靠著對同盟國的讓步撐過二戰。
body.en: The regime's military origins kept Salazar's position linked to that of President Carmona, who retained the authority to dismiss any of his appointed officials, including Salazar. The New State became radicalized with the outbreak of the civil war in neighboring Spain in 1936. After declaring neutrality in 1939, the dictatorship survived the Second World War, thanks mainly to its concessions to the Allied Powers.

body.zh-Hant: 二戰後，薩拉查最憂心的是去殖民化；1960年代初非洲民族主義運動展開武裝鬥爭，引爆殖民戰爭。1968年他心血管發病後被免除職務，1970年逝世。
body.en: After 1945 decolonization most concerned Salazar; at the start of the 1960s African nationalist movements began armed struggle, leading to colonial wars. After a cardiovascular attack in 1968 he was removed from power, and he died in 1970.

body.zh-Hant: 特魯希略1891年10月24日生，聖克里斯托瓦爾人，做過電報員與保安。1918年加入美國占領軍成立的國民警衛隊；1924年該隊改為國家警察，他成為首長，1928年再改為國家武裝部隊時出任總司令，到1930年已當上總統。
body.en: Trujillo, a native of San Cristóbal who had been a telegraph operator and security guard, was born on 24 October 1891. He joined the National Guard established by the U.S. occupation in 1918 and became chief officer when it became the National Police in 1924 and commander in chief when it became the National Armed Forces in 1928, and was president by 1930.

body.zh-Hant: 此後十年間，特魯希略建立了拉丁美洲前所未見的極權控制。1937年10月，據估計有兩萬五千名海地人被他的手下殺害。他在1934年舞弊連任；1938年起扶植傀儡總統遙控政局，1940年培那多死後由特龍索索繼任總統。
body.en: During the following decade Trujillo established the most totalitarian control any Latin American country had yet seen. In October 1937 an estimated 25,000 Haitians were slain by his agents. After being fraudulently reelected in 1934, he began in 1938 installing puppet presidents; after Peynado's death in 1940 Troncoso became president.

body.zh-Hant: 美國參戰後，多明尼加是最早對軸心國宣戰的拉美國家之一。1944年局勢明朗時，特魯希略准許成立若干反對黨以製造「政治開放」；1947年冷戰開始後，他逮捕、刑求並殺害這些反對派領袖，終止了這場嘗試。
body.en: When the United States entered the Second World War, the Dominican Republic was among the first Latin American countries to declare war on the Axis. When it became clear by 1944 that the democracies would win, Trujillo allowed several opposition parties to form as a 'political opening'; using the start of the Cold War in 1947, he ended the experiment by arresting, torturing and killing their leaders.

heading.en: From minister of war to the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 烏維科曾在奧雷亞納總統任內擔任戰爭部長（起訖年來源不一）。他在大蕭條的動盪年代經全票當選總統，1931至1944年任瓜地馬拉總統。
body.en: Ubico served as minister of war under President José María Orellana (sources differ on the years). He came to power as president by unanimous election during the turbulent years of the Great Depression and was president of Guatemala from 1931 to 1944.

body.zh-Hant: 烏維科興建了全國第一個公路與電報網。1934年的流浪法廢除債務奴役，改為對國家的勞動義務。他以安全部隊監控民眾，無情壓制政治反對派。
body.en: Ubico built the nation's first highway and telegraph networks. The Vagrancy Law of 1934 abolished debt peonage and substituted a labor obligation to the state. Security forces watched the populace and political opposition was ruthlessly suppressed.

body.zh-Hant: 1944年，由學生、年輕軍官與不滿的城市中產階級發起的反抗推翻了烏維科政權。他流亡美國，1946年6月14日去世。
body.en: In 1944 the Ubico regime was overthrown by a revolt led by students, junior military officers and disgruntled members of the urban middle class. He went into exile in the United States, where he died on 14 June 1946.
